test_title: PYST 80: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ports was developed as a Satellite port to relieve the pressure at the Mumbai port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru Port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru Port, also known as Nhava Sheva, is the largest container port in India.
 
• It was commissioned on 26 May 1989 to relieve the pressure on the Mumbai Port.
 
• Located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, it handles around 55-60% of the country's containerized cargo.
 
• The port is named after Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New Mangalore Port**

 
 
• Located in Panambur, Mangalore, Karnataka.
 
• It is a major port on the west coast of India.
 
• It primarily handles cargo like crude oil, petroleum products, and fertilizers.
 
 
 
• **Marmagao Port**
 
 
• Located in the state of Goa.
 
• It is one of India's oldest ports, known for handling iron ore exports.
 
• It plays a significant role in the economy of Goa.
 
 
 
• **Deendayal Port Authority**
 
 
• Formerly known as Kandla Port.
 
• Located in the Kutch district of Gujarat.
 
• It is one of the largest ports in India in terms of cargo handled.
 
 

This structured code provides a detailed solution that explains why Jawaharlal Nehru Port is the correct answer and gives additional information about the other options.
